programme.desc: Highlights and Catfights: A look back at series 16's most dramatic moments - along with some behind-the-scenes footage - before the remaining contestants jet off to Morocco.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Boy-Scoutz 'n the Hood: During an all-syrup Squishee bender, Bart joins the junior campers, and ends up taking the embarrassing - and dangerous - Homer on a river rafting trip.

programme.title: Young Sheldon
programme.desc: Gluons, Guacamole, and the Color Purple: Sheldon feels academically unchallenged at school, so he audits a college class taught by his pen pal, Dr John Sturgis.

programme.title: Young Sheldon
programme.desc: A Dog, a Squirrel, and a Fish Named Fish: A neighbourhood feud erupts between the Coopers and the Sparks family when the Sparks' new dog terrorises Sheldon.

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: Whanex?: While preparing a presentation for his students about future goals, Cam must contend with a bully at the school. Jay has technical trouble during a video conference.

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: Stop Arguing and Start Thanking: When Beverly invites Murray's unreliable brother Marvin to visit at Thanksgiving, she reignites their long-standing feud.

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: Shopping: Erica's new job at a department store is put in jeopardy when Beverly takes advantage of her daughter's employee discount far too frequently.

programme.title: The Neighborhood
programme.desc: Welcome to the Dream Girls: Tina reunites with her former girl group after decades apart, but old issues threaten their big performance.

programme.title: The Neighborhood
programme.desc: Welcome to the Ring: As Marty prepares to propose to his girlfriend, Calvin and Tina plan a party honouring their future daughter-in-law's Nigerian heritage.

programme.title: Rude(ish) Tube Shorts
programme.desc: A short, cheeky clip from Rude Tube's naughty little sister Rude(ish) Tube, featuring sheep.

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: Man of the House: Erica's graduation is eclipsed by excitement about the new baby. Adam and Barry fight for the title of 'man of the house' in Murray's absence.

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: Uncle-ing: Erica asks Geoff to take her on a 'babymoon' to get her far away from Beverly. But then Erica's water breaks and she goes into labour...

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: DKNY: Adam visits Dave Kim at NYU to celebrate Halloween. Geoff's fear of Beverly taking over baby care duties turns into a jump-scare-filled comedic thriller.

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: Rhinestones and Roses: Beverly embraces her new life as a grandmother while trying to stay young at heart, and Adam gets a job while he waits to start at NYU.

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: Another Turkey in the Trot: Adam and Barry are determined to give Beverly a joyous conflict-free Thanksgiving, but their plans go awry.

programme.title: Dora and the Lost City of Gold
programme.desc: (2019) Family adventure with Isabela Moner, Eva Longoria and Michael Peña. Everyone's favourite young explorer must track down her parents, who are missing in Peru.

programme.title: Monster House
programme.desc: (2006) Spooky animated caper with Maggie Gyllenhaal and Steve Buscemi. A young boy and his babysitter spy on the creepy neighbour. Did he really eat his wife?

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: Zayna Flaming Grill (Part 1/2): Gordon makes the first of two visits to Zayna Flaming Grill, a Mediterranean restaurant in Redondo Beach owned by Faye and her niece Brenda.

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: Zayna Flaming Grill (Part 2/2): Gordon returns to California for the conclusion of his challenge to save Zayna Flaming Grill. Can he inject flavour into the tired menu?

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Hot Tub Contamination: Leonard and Penny intervene when Sheldon and Amy have an argument. Howard and Bernadette are disturbed by unexpected guests.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Fetal Kick Catalyst: Penny meets her fans at a comic book convention. Sheldon and Amy host brunch at Penny's flat. Howard makes an impulsive purchase.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Veracity Elasticity: Leonard is upset when he finds out that Penny has been moving his collectables out of Sheldon's old room and into storage behind his back.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Brain Bowl Incubation: Sheldon tries to convince Amy that they should procreate. Raj feels embarrassed about what the new woman in his life does for a living.

programme.title: The Great Christmas Bake Off
programme.desc: Merry bakers from Bake Off past - Val, Selasi, Paul and Beca - join Paul, Prue, Noel and Sandi to compete in festive challenges for the title of Star Baker. (Ep1/2)

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Beyond Blunderdome: Mel Gibson hires Homer to help him rewrite his remake of Mr Smith Goes to Washington.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: E-I-E-I-(Annoyed Grunt): The Simpsons are forced to flee to the countryside, where Homer accidentally invents highly addictive tomacco. But the animals like it too...

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: The Last Temptation of Homer: Homer falls for his beautiful new colleague Mindy Simmons (guest star Michelle Pfeiffer), who shares his love of doughnuts...

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: $pringfield (or How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love Legalized Gambling): Homer gets a job at Mr Burns' new casino and Marge gets addicted to the slot machines.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Homer the Vigilante: Homer sets up a chaotic vigilante group to combat one-man crime spree Molloy (guest star Sam Neill).

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Bart Gets Famous: Thanks to his new catchphrase, 'I didn't do it', Bart becomes famous, getting his own TV series and releasing a range of merchandise.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Homer and Apu: When Apu loses the Kwik-E-Mart, he moves in with the Simpsons. And then Homer joins him on a pilgrimage to the first ever Kwik-E-Mart, in the Himalayas.

programme.desc: Homemade Holiday. Ree Drummond makes festive, edible Christmas gifts for friends, including spiced rolls, yummy onion jam, a cookie baking kit and a comforting soup. S37, Ep12

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Fast And Festive 4 Ways. Ree Drummond shares quick, easy recipes that are perfect for the holidays, like an amazing breakfast hash, stress-free pizza dip and a festive soup. S37, Ep8

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Ask Me: Holiday Favorites. Ree Drummond answers questions about holiday favourites while making a special breakfast dish, a crowd-pleasing sauce and a quick toffee dessert. S37, Ep13

programme.title: Mary Berry's Country House At Christmas
programme.desc: Mary Berry visits Harewood House in Yorkshire as it's being prepared for a magical Christmas. She shows how to make delicious modern recipes inspired by festive dishes of the past.

programme.title: James Martin And Christmas Friends
programme.desc: James Martin invites some of his celebrity friends round for a festive feast. He's joined by actor Jimi Mistry and chef Paul Ainsworth gives his take on a Christmas lunch. S1, Ep1

programme.title: James Martin And Christmas Friends
programme.desc: James Martin invites chef Brian Turner and actor Jennie McAlpine round for a festive feast including shoulder of pork. Plus, Ching-He Huang cooks a yuletide Asian treat. S1, Ep2

programme.title: James Martin's Christmas Feasts
programme.desc: Chef James Martin creates a special Christmas menu. He serves up figs and apple chutney, Yorkshire pot with creamed leeks, Stollen cake and biscotti. S1, Ep1

programme.title: James Martin: Sweet
programme.desc: Festive. James Martin puts festive desserts under the spotlight. He focuses on the staples - sugar, cream, strawberries and fresh fruit. But, which festive desserts will he make? S1, Ep14

programme.title: Michel Roux's Provence Masterclass
programme.desc: Sunday Lunch. Michel takes Sunday lunch to the next level. He serves fish quenelles, chicken cooked in salt crust pastry and red wine poached pears with galette serpentine. S1, Ep1

programme.title: Michel Roux: Christmas in Provence
programme.desc: Michel cooks the best produce Southern France has to offer. Friends and family join the festivities as he serves up delicious Christmas dishes and the perfect festive drinks.

programme.title: Marcus Wareing At Christmas
programme.desc: Christmas Baking. Marcus makes some festive bakes including a decadent salmon Pithivier, a warming ginger cake and a scrumptious citrus enhanced treacle tart. S1, Ep7

programme.title: Marcus Wareing At Christmas
programme.desc: Open House Party Food. Marcus shares his favourite festive finger food, from deliciously bite-size donuts to stress-free chicken wings and crispy roast spuds with a trio of dips. S1, Ep8

programme.title: Marcus Wareing At Christmas
programme.desc: Christmas Leftovers. Marcus turns seasonal surplus into magnificent meals, from bubble and squeak pie to an Asian-style slaw with shredded turkey and a Christmas pudding Eton Mess. S1, Ep9

programme.title: Marcus Wareing At Christmas
programme.desc: Marcus Wareing gets feast-ready for Christmas with his favourite go-to recipes. He uses his world-class chef skills to create festive showstoppers. S1, Ep10

programme.title: Nigel Slater's Christmas Suppers
programme.desc: Culinary champion Nigel Slater reveals fantastic festive recipes, including transforming any left-over bird into his scrumptious perky turkey dish.

programme.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Cooking Christmas Special
programme.desc: Nigel Slater reveals fantastic festive recipes, including a sumptuous casserole, that will warm cockles and fill hungry stomachs throughout the Christmas period.

programme.title: Nigel Slater's 12 Tastes Of Christmas
programme.desc: Nigel Slater shares his favourite festive dishes, from tempting treats to a feast on the big day. And, in Norway he sees how Scandinavian flavours capture the essence of Christmas.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives

programme.desc: The chef is on the road in his bespoke vintage food truck in Andalucia. Wine chemist Joaquin explains the patience needed to produce sherry vinegar in the famed sherry triangle, before putting Tom to the test alongside blender Ramon to see if he can produce a blend good enough to match their best vintage. Tom's journey then takes him to Cadiz, where avocados have become big business. There local producer Rafa shows him the work being done to help grow this thirsty plant

programme.desc: James is joined by chef and restaurateur Mark Sargeant in Kent, where they cook on the regenerated Folkestone Harbour Arm they and visit a sourdough and beer suppliers located in a shipping container. programme.title: Love Your Garden
programme.desc: Alan Titchmarsh and the team look to the natural world for inspiration this time and create a wild and woolly garden that's perfect for a deserving young family in Middlesbrough. Despite having physical challenges of her own, young mum Phillipa supports other disabled families and individuals in the area, going above and beyond to make sure they have all the help they need. The garden features a mini-dinosaur kingdom play area, a natural-looking water feature and a vertical grow-your-own vegetable plot, and the team succeeds in transforming the family's modest suburban plot into a slice of the great outdoors with something for each of them

programme.desc: England v China (Kick-off 5.30pm). Laura Woods presents all the action from the friendly at Wembley Stadium.
